boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of California-Santa Cruz
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and dessert stops in Santa Cruz with published late availability.

cards.title: Pizza My Heart
cards.subtitle: 1116 Pacific Ave, Santa Cruz
cards.notes: Use the downtown counter-service location when you need a food stop later in the evening; confirm holiday exceptions before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: Downtown pizza with a published midnight closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza My Heart lists its Santa Cruz location at 1116 Pacific Ave and publishes daily hours of 11 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11 a.m.–midnight daily. Check the business page for exceptions.
